collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager hums the same tune while working without knowing it, and the high bit is getting to a neighbor.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) hums while (subject.he/she) works. (subject.He/She) has no idea (subject.he/she) does it. It's always the same tune, a cheerful little thing with a bit in the middle that goes very high. Today (friend) has been working next to (subject.him/her) all morning, and the high bit is starting to get to (friend.him/her).

choices.label: Say Nothing and Move a Little Further Away

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "You know you've been humming all morning?" says (friend). (subject) is astonished. "I don't hum." (subject.He/She) goes back to work. Within a minute (subject.he/she) is humming again. (friend) gives up and starts humming along, and by lunchtime the two of them have worked out a harmony for the high bit.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) shifts to the other end of the field. From here the humming is soft and pleasant, like a bird a long way off. (friend) finds (friend.him/her)self working to the rhythm of it. That night (friend.he/she) catches (friend.him/her)self humming the tune at dinner and stops, quite horrified.
